title: Running
description: A Garmin watch's runs, as garmin-grafana writes them (ActivitySummary, ActivityLap, ActivityGPS, VO2_Max): volume and regularity, intensity, every 10 km compared on its best 10 km with the running dynamics, pace, heart rate and fitness run by run, running form, and the resting heart rate and HRV of the same weeks.

list.name: tz
list.label: Time zone
list.description: IANA time zone the days and weeks are cut in (TRIBUTARY_TZ).

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.description: The person, in SleepStats (GarminStats holds one person and has no user tag).
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "sleep_session" WITH KEY = "user"
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "sleep_session" WITH KEY = "user"

list.name: nights
list.label: Night sources
list.description: Every source of nights in SleepStats, for the heart pickers.
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "sleep_session" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "sleep_session" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'

list.name: rhr_from
list.label: Resting HR from
list.description: The source of the resting heart rate.

list.name: hrv_from
list.label: HRV from
list.description: The source of the overnight HRV. Devices measure it differently.

list.name: z3
list.label: Zone 3 from
list.description: The watch's lower bound of heart-rate zone 3: below it, a second of running is easy.

list.name: z4
list.label: Zone 4 from
list.description: The watch's lower bound of heart-rate zone 4: from it, a second of running is hard.

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Runs in the time range: activities whose type contains "run", 1 km or longer.

targets.query: SELECT count("distance") FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Distance
panels.description: Total distance run.

targets.query: SELECT sum("distance") / 1000 FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Time running
panels.description: Total time, pauses included (the activities' elapsed time).

targets.query: SELECT sum("elapsedDuration") / 3600 FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Average run
panels.description: Mean distance of a run.

targets.query: SELECT mean("distance") / 1000 FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Average pace
panels.description: Total moving time over total distance (stops left out), per km.

targets.query: SELECT sum("movingDuration") / sum("distance") * 1000 FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Runs of 10 km+
panels.description: Runs of 10 km or more (to within the 50 m a watch loses).

targets.query: SELECT count("distance") FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND "distance" >= 9950 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Best 10 km
panels.description: The fastest 10 consecutive 1 km laps of any run in the range (the 10 km row lists them).

targets.query: SELECT min("best") FROM (SELECT min("t") AS "best", "hr", "step", "gct", "vo", "vr", "ascent", "temp" FROM (SELECT moving_average("Elapsed_Time", 10) / moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10000 AS "t", moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10 AS "d", moving_average("Avg_HR", 10) AS "hr", moving_average("Avg_Step_Length", 10) / 1000 AS "step", moving_average("Avg_Stance_Time", 10) AS "gct", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Oscillation", 10) / 10 AS "vo", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Ratio", 10) AS "vr", moving_average("Ascent", 10) * 10 AS "ascent", moving_average("Avg_Temperature", 10) AS "temp" FROM "ActivityLap" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID", "ActivitySelector") WHERE "d" >= 9950 AND "d" <= 10050 GROUP BY "ActivityID")

panels.title: VO₂ max
panels.description: The watch's latest running VO₂ max in the range.

targets.query: SELECT last("VO2_max_value") FROM "VO2_Max" WHERE "VO2_max_value" > 0 AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Longest run
panels.description: The longest run's distance.

targets.query: SELECT max("distance") / 1000 FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Longest run, time
panels.description: The longest run's elapsed time.

targets.query: SELECT max("elapsedDuration") FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Shortest run
panels.description: The shortest run's distance (runs under 1 km are not counted).

targets.query: SELECT min("distance") / 1000 FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Shortest run, time
panels.description: The shortest run's elapsed time.

targets.query: SELECT min("elapsedDuration") FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Runs / week
panels.description: Runs per week, averaged over the time range.

targets.query: SELECT count("distance") * 604800000 / (${__to} - ${__from}) FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Last run
panels.description: When the latest run in the range started.

targets.query: SELECT last("distance") FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Climbing
panels.description: Total elevation gain of the runs that recorded one (the watch's own figure; the older imports have none).

targets.query: SELECT sum("elevationGain") FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Average heart rate
panels.description: Mean of the runs' average heart rates.

targets.query: SELECT mean("averageHR") FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND "averageHR" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Distance per week
panels.description: Kilometres run each week (bars, weeks start on Monday) and the average of the last 4 weeks (line). A week far above its line is a jump in load: the usual advice is to add no more than about 10% a week.

targets.query: SELECT sum("distance") / 1000 FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(sum("distance"), 4) / 1000 FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND time >= ${__from}ms - 28d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE time >= ${__from}ms - 28d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Runs per week
panels.description: Number of runs each week.

targets.query: SELECT count("distance") FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Days since the previous run
panels.description: For each run, the days since the one before. Long gaps followed by a hard run are when an injury is most likely.

targets.query: SELECT elapsed("distance", 1d) FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Distance of each run
panels.description: One point per run; the dashed line is 10 km.

targets.query: SELECT "distance" / 1000 AS "km" FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: How long the runs are
panels.description: Number of runs per 1 km of distance.

targets.query: SELECT "distance" / 1000 AS "km" FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Easy running
panels.description: Each second of running with a heart rate, by intensity, from the watch's own heart-rate zones (the latest ones it reported, so every year is cut the same way): easy below zone 3, moderate in zone 3, hard in zones 4 and 5. Most training plans keep about 80% of the running easy. This tile: its share of the time range's running seconds.

targets.query: SELECT count("HeartRate") AS "part" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND "HeartRate" > 0 AND "HeartRate" < $z3 AND $timeFilter
SELECT count("HeartRate") AS "all" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND "HeartRate" > 0 AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Hard running
panels.description: Each second of running with a heart rate, by intensity, from the watch's own heart-rate zones (the latest ones it reported, so every year is cut the same way): easy below zone 3, moderate in zone 3, hard in zones 4 and 5. Most training plans keep about 80% of the running easy. This tile: its share of the time range's running seconds.

targets.query: SELECT count("HeartRate") AS "part" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND "HeartRate" >= $z4 AND $timeFilter
SELECT count("HeartRate") AS "all" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND "HeartRate" > 0 AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Easy, moderate and hard, share of each week
panels.description: Each second of running with a heart rate, by intensity, from the watch's own heart-rate zones (the latest ones it reported, so every year is cut the same way): easy below zone 3, moderate in zone 3, hard in zones 4 and 5. Most training plans keep about 80% of the running easy.

targets.query: SELECT count("HeartRate") FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND "HeartRate" > 0 AND "HeartRate" < $z3 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')
SELECT count("HeartRate") FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND "HeartRate" >= $z3 AND "HeartRate" < $z4 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')
SELECT count("HeartRate") FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND "HeartRate" >= $z4 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Training effect of each run
panels.description: Garmin's aerobic and anaerobic training effect, 0 to 5, per run (watches from about 2016; older imports have none). 3 to 4 improves, above 4 is highly improving or overreaching: many runs above 4 in a row is a lot of hard running.

targets.query: SELECT "aerobicTrainingEffect" AS "aerobic" FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT "anaerobicTrainingEffect" AS "anaerobic" FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Training load of each run
panels.description: Garmin's training load (EPOC) per run, and the average of the last 5 runs.

targets.query: SELECT "activityTrainingLoad" AS "load" FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND "activityTrainingLoad" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT moving_average("activityTrainingLoad", 5) AS "trend" FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND "activityTrainingLoad" > 0 AND time >= ${__from}ms - 365d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE time >= ${__from}ms - 365d AND time <= ${__to}ms

panels.title: Every 10 km, on its best 10 km
panels.description: Every run of 10 km or more, compared on its best 10 km: its fastest 10 consecutive 1 km laps (the watch's auto-lap), and what the laps measured over the same 10 km. A run without 1 km laps (manual laps, an import without its laps) shows its totals only. Columns from Best 10 km to Temperature are the best 10 km's; Distance, Time, Cadence, training effect and load are the whole run's. Click a header to sort.

targets.query: SELECT "distance" / 1000 AS "Distance", "elapsedDuration" AS "Duration", "activityName" AS "Name", "aerobicTrainingEffect" AS "Aerobic TE", "activityTrainingLoad" AS "Load" FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND "distance" >= 9950 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID"

SELECT min("t") AS "Best 10 km", "t" / 10 AS "Pace", "hr" AS "Heart rate", "hr" * "t" / 600 AS "Beats / km", "step" AS "Step length", "gct" AS "Ground contact", "vo" AS "Vertical oscillation", "vr" AS "Vertical ratio", "ascent" AS "Ascent", "temp" AS "Temperature" FROM (SELECT moving_average("Elapsed_Time", 10) / moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10000 AS "t", moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10 AS "d", moving_average("Avg_HR", 10) AS "hr", moving_average("Avg_Step_Length", 10) / 1000 AS "step", moving_average("Avg_Stance_Time", 10) AS "gct", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Oscillation", 10) / 10 AS "vo", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Ratio", 10) AS "vr", moving_average("Ascent", 10) * 10 AS "ascent", moving_average("Avg_Temperature", 10) AS "temp" FROM "ActivityLap" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID", "ActivitySelector") WHERE "d" >= 9950 AND "d" <= 10050 GROUP BY "ActivityID"
SELECT mean("Cadence") * 2 + mean("Fractional_Cadence") * 2 AS "Cadence" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND "Cadence" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID"

panels.title: Best 10 km time
panels.description: Each run's best 10 km, and the average of the last 5. Lower is faster.

targets.query: SELECT "best" AS "v" FROM (SELECT min("t") AS "best", "hr", "step", "gct", "vo", "vr", "ascent", "temp" FROM (SELECT moving_average("Elapsed_Time", 10) / moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10000 AS "t", moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10 AS "d", moving_average("Avg_HR", 10) AS "hr", moving_average("Avg_Step_Length", 10) / 1000 AS "step", moving_average("Avg_Stance_Time", 10) AS "gct", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Oscillation", 10) / 10 AS "vo", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Ratio", 10) AS "vr", moving_average("Ascent", 10) * 10 AS "ascent", moving_average("Avg_Temperature", 10) AS "temp" FROM "ActivityLap" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID", "ActivitySelector") WHERE "d" >= 9950 AND "d" <= 10050 GROUP BY "ActivityID")

SELECT moving_average("v", 5) AS "trend" FROM (SELECT "best" AS "v" FROM (SELECT min("t") AS "best", "hr", "step", "gct", "vo", "vr", "ascent", "temp" FROM (SELECT moving_average("Elapsed_Time", 10) / moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10000 AS "t", moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10 AS "d", moving_average("Avg_HR", 10) AS "hr", moving_average("Avg_Step_Length", 10) / 1000 AS "step", moving_average("Avg_Stance_Time", 10) AS "gct", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Oscillation", 10) / 10 AS "vo", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Ratio", 10) AS "vr", moving_average("Ascent", 10) * 10 AS "ascent", moving_average("Avg_Temperature", 10) AS "temp" FROM "ActivityLap" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID", "ActivitySelector") WHERE "d" >= 9950 AND "d" <= 10050 GROUP BY "ActivityID"))

panels.title: Heart rate on the best 10 km
panels.description: Mean of the 10 laps' average heart rates.

targets.query: SELECT "hr" AS "v" FROM (SELECT min("t") AS "best", "hr", "step", "gct", "vo", "vr", "ascent", "temp" FROM (SELECT moving_average("Elapsed_Time", 10) / moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10000 AS "t", moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10 AS "d", moving_average("Avg_HR", 10) AS "hr", moving_average("Avg_Step_Length", 10) / 1000 AS "step", moving_average("Avg_Stance_Time", 10) AS "gct", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Oscillation", 10) / 10 AS "vo", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Ratio", 10) AS "vr", moving_average("Ascent", 10) * 10 AS "ascent", moving_average("Avg_Temperature", 10) AS "temp" FROM "ActivityLap" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID", "ActivitySelector") WHERE "d" >= 9950 AND "d" <= 10050 GROUP BY "ActivityID")

SELECT moving_average("v", 5) AS "trend" FROM (SELECT "hr" AS "v" FROM (SELECT min("t") AS "best", "hr", "step", "gct", "vo", "vr", "ascent", "temp" FROM (SELECT moving_average("Elapsed_Time", 10) / moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10000 AS "t", moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10 AS "d", moving_average("Avg_HR", 10) AS "hr", moving_average("Avg_Step_Length", 10) / 1000 AS "step", moving_average("Avg_Stance_Time", 10) AS "gct", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Oscillation", 10) / 10 AS "vo", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Ratio", 10) AS "vr", moving_average("Ascent", 10) * 10 AS "ascent", moving_average("Avg_Temperature", 10) AS "temp" FROM "ActivityLap" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID", "ActivitySelector") WHERE "d" >= 9950 AND "d" <= 10050 GROUP BY "ActivityID"))

panels.title: Heartbeats per km on the best 10 km
panels.description: Average heart rate times pace: the beats one km costs. Lower is more economical: running as fast for fewer beats, or faster for the same.

targets.query: SELECT "hr" * "best" / 600 AS "v" FROM (SELECT min("t") AS "best", "hr", "step", "gct", "vo", "vr", "ascent", "temp" FROM (SELECT moving_average("Elapsed_Time", 10) / moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10000 AS "t", moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10 AS "d", moving_average("Avg_HR", 10) AS "hr", moving_average("Avg_Step_Length", 10) / 1000 AS "step", moving_average("Avg_Stance_Time", 10) AS "gct", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Oscillation", 10) / 10 AS "vo", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Ratio", 10) AS "vr", moving_average("Ascent", 10) * 10 AS "ascent", moving_average("Avg_Temperature", 10) AS "temp" FROM "ActivityLap" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID", "ActivitySelector") WHERE "d" >= 9950 AND "d" <= 10050 GROUP BY "ActivityID")

SELECT moving_average("v", 5) AS "trend" FROM (SELECT "hr" * "best" / 600 AS "v" FROM (SELECT min("t") AS "best", "hr", "step", "gct", "vo", "vr", "ascent", "temp" FROM (SELECT moving_average("Elapsed_Time", 10) / moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10000 AS "t", moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10 AS "d", moving_average("Avg_HR", 10) AS "hr", moving_average("Avg_Step_Length", 10) / 1000 AS "step", moving_average("Avg_Stance_Time", 10) AS "gct", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Oscillation", 10) / 10 AS "vo", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Ratio", 10) AS "vr", moving_average("Ascent", 10) * 10 AS "ascent", moving_average("Avg_Temperature", 10) AS "temp" FROM "ActivityLap" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID", "ActivitySelector") WHERE "d" >= 9950 AND "d" <= 10050 GROUP BY "ActivityID"))

panels.title: Step length on the best 10 km
panels.description: Mean step length over the 10 laps. Needs a running dynamics sensor (a chest strap or pod); older runs have none.

targets.query: SELECT "step" AS "v" FROM (SELECT min("t") AS "best", "hr", "step", "gct", "vo", "vr", "ascent", "temp" FROM (SELECT moving_average("Elapsed_Time", 10) / moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10000 AS "t", moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10 AS "d", moving_average("Avg_HR", 10) AS "hr", moving_average("Avg_Step_Length", 10) / 1000 AS "step", moving_average("Avg_Stance_Time", 10) AS "gct", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Oscillation", 10) / 10 AS "vo", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Ratio", 10) AS "vr", moving_average("Ascent", 10) * 10 AS "ascent", moving_average("Avg_Temperature", 10) AS "temp" FROM "ActivityLap" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID", "ActivitySelector") WHERE "d" >= 9950 AND "d" <= 10050 GROUP BY "ActivityID")

SELECT moving_average("v", 5) AS "trend" FROM (SELECT "step" AS "v" FROM (SELECT min("t") AS "best", "hr", "step", "gct", "vo", "vr", "ascent", "temp" FROM (SELECT moving_average("Elapsed_Time", 10) / moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10000 AS "t", moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10 AS "d", moving_average("Avg_HR", 10) AS "hr", moving_average("Avg_Step_Length", 10) / 1000 AS "step", moving_average("Avg_Stance_Time", 10) AS "gct", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Oscillation", 10) / 10 AS "vo", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Ratio", 10) AS "vr", moving_average("Ascent", 10) * 10 AS "ascent", moving_average("Avg_Temperature", 10) AS "temp" FROM "ActivityLap" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID", "ActivitySelector") WHERE "d" >= 9950 AND "d" <= 10050 GROUP BY "ActivityID"))

panels.title: Cadence on the best 10 km
panels.description: Steps per minute over the 10 laps: their speed over their step length. Needs a running dynamics sensor (a chest strap or pod); older runs have none.

targets.query: SELECT 600000 / ("best" * "step") AS "v" FROM (SELECT min("t") AS "best", "hr", "step", "gct", "vo", "vr", "ascent", "temp" FROM (SELECT moving_average("Elapsed_Time", 10) / moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10000 AS "t", moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10 AS "d", moving_average("Avg_HR", 10) AS "hr", moving_average("Avg_Step_Length", 10) / 1000 AS "step", moving_average("Avg_Stance_Time", 10) AS "gct", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Oscillation", 10) / 10 AS "vo", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Ratio", 10) AS "vr", moving_average("Ascent", 10) * 10 AS "ascent", moving_average("Avg_Temperature", 10) AS "temp" FROM "ActivityLap" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID", "ActivitySelector") WHERE "d" >= 9950 AND "d" <= 10050 GROUP BY "ActivityID")

SELECT moving_average("v", 5) AS "trend" FROM (SELECT 600000 / ("best" * "step") AS "v" FROM (SELECT min("t") AS "best", "hr", "step", "gct", "vo", "vr", "ascent", "temp" FROM (SELECT moving_average("Elapsed_Time", 10) / moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10000 AS "t", moving_average("Distance", 10) * 10 AS "d", moving_average("Avg_HR", 10) AS "hr", moving_average("Avg_Step_Length", 10) / 1000 AS "step", moving_average("Avg_Stance_Time", 10) AS "gct", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Oscillation", 10) / 10 AS "vo", moving_average("Avg_Vertical_Ratio", 10) AS "vr", moving_average("Ascent", 10) * 10 AS "ascent", moving_average("Avg_Temperature", 10) AS "temp" FROM "ActivityLap" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID", "ActivitySelector") WHERE "d" >= 9950 AND "d" <= 10050 GROUP BY "ActivityID"))

panels.title: Every run: pace, heart and fitness
Pace of each run
panels.description: Moving pace (stops left out) of each run, and the average of the last 10 runs. Lower is faster.

targets.query: SELECT "movingDuration" / "distance" * 1000 AS "v" FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT moving_average("v", 10) AS "trend" FROM (SELECT "movingDuration" / "distance" * 1000 AS "v" FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND time >= ${__from}ms - 365d AND time <= ${__to}ms) GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE time >= ${__from}ms - 365d AND time <= ${__to}ms

panels.title: Heart rate of each run
panels.description: Average heart rate of each run, and of the last 10 runs.

targets.query: SELECT "averageHR" AS "v" FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND "averageHR" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT moving_average("v", 10) AS "trend" FROM (SELECT "averageHR" AS "v" FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND "averageHR" > 0 AND time >= ${__from}ms - 365d AND time <= ${__to}ms) GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE time >= ${__from}ms - 365d AND time <= ${__to}ms

panels.title: Heartbeats per km
panels.description: Average heart rate times moving pace: the beats a km costs, run by run. Falling over months at the same kind of run is aerobic fitness improving; rising for a few runs can be fatigue, heat or illness.

targets.query: SELECT "averageHR" * "movingDuration" / "distance" * 1000 / 60 AS "v" FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND "averageHR" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT moving_average("v", 10) AS "trend" FROM (SELECT "averageHR" * "movingDuration" / "distance" * 1000 / 60 AS "v" FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND "averageHR" > 0 AND time >= ${__from}ms - 365d AND time <= ${__to}ms) GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE time >= ${__from}ms - 365d AND time <= ${__to}ms

panels.title: VO₂ max
panels.description: The watch's running VO₂ max estimate, each time it changes. Higher is fitter.

targets.query: SELECT max("VO2_max_value") FROM "VO2_Max" WHERE "VO2_max_value" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Cadence
panels.description: Steps per minute, each run's mean over the seconds it was moving (the watch's own cadence, every run that has its per-second data).

targets.query: SELECT mean("Cadence") * 2 + mean("Fractional_Cadence") * 2 AS "cadence" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND "Cadence" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Step length
panels.description: Each run's mean speed over its mean cadence: the distance of one step, available for every run with per-second data (a running dynamics sensor measures it directly; this needs none).

targets.query: SELECT mean("Speed") * 30 / (mean("Cadence") + mean("Fractional_Cadence")) AS "step" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND "Cadence" > 0 AND "Speed" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Ground contact time
panels.description: How long each foot stays on the ground. Each run's mean. Needs a running dynamics sensor (a chest strap or pod); older runs have none.

targets.query: SELECT mean("Stance_Time") AS "v" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND "Stance_Time" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Vertical oscillation
panels.description: How far the body bounces at each step. Each run's mean. Needs a running dynamics sensor (a chest strap or pod); older runs have none.

targets.query: SELECT mean("Vertical_Oscillation") / 10 AS "v" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND "Vertical_Oscillation" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Vertical ratio
panels.description: Vertical oscillation over step length. Each run's mean. Needs a running dynamics sensor (a chest strap or pod); older runs have none.

targets.query: SELECT mean("Vertical_Ratio") AS "v" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND "Vertical_Ratio" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Distance per week
panels.description: Kilometres run each week, to read the two graphs below against.

targets.query: SELECT sum("distance") / 1000 FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Resting heart rate per week
panels.description: Weekly averages, under the running of the same weeks: a resting heart rate climbing, or an HRV falling, for more than a few days after a heavy week is the body asking for rest. Read from the source picked in *Resting HR from*.

targets.query: SELECT mean("restingHeartRate") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND 'garmin' = '${rhr_from}' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("resting_hr") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${rhr_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("value") FROM "RestingHR" WHERE 'fitbit' = '${rhr_from}' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: HRV per week
panels.description: Weekly averages, under the running of the same weeks: a resting heart rate climbing, or an HRV falling, for more than a few days after a heavy week is the body asking for rest. Read from the source picked in *HRV from*.

targets.query: SELECT mean("avgOvernightHrv") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND 'garmin' = '${hrv_from}' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("hrv_rmssd_ms") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${hrv_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("dailyRmssd") FROM "HRV" WHERE 'fitbit' = '${hrv_from}' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Every run in the time range, latest first. Pace is the moving pace; Ascent is the watch's elevation gain (the older imports have none); Cadence is the mean over the seconds moving. Click a header to sort.

targets.query: SELECT "activityName" AS "Name", "activityType" AS "Type", "distance" / 1000 AS "Distance", "elapsedDuration" AS "Duration", "movingDuration" / "distance" * 1000 AS "Pace", "averageHR" AS "Heart rate", "maxHR" AS "Max heart rate", "averageHR" * "movingDuration" / "distance" * 1000 / 60 AS "Beats / km", "aerobicTrainingEffect" AS "Aerobic TE", "anaerobicTrainingEffect" AS "Anaerobic TE", "activityTrainingLoad" AS "Load", "calories" AS "Calories", "elevationGain" AS "Ascent" FROM (SELECT max("distance") AS "distance", "elapsedDuration", "movingDuration", "averageHR", "maxHR", "aerobicTrainingEffect", "anaerobicTrainingEffect", "activityTrainingLoad", "calories", "elevationGain", "activityName", "activityType" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /run/ AND "distance" >= 1000 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID"
SELECT mean("Cadence") * 2 + mean("Fractional_Cadence") * 2 AS "Cadence" FROM "ActivityGPS" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /run/ AND "Cadence" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "ActivityID"
